note: Gold for real-estate real questions the pooled judge marked unanswerable but the corpus answers; found by searching the statutes directly (Claude Code, 2026-11-13). Each is the provision the question names (RESPA section 8 = 12 U.S.C. 2607) or the remedy a Korean housing-lease guide gives (임차권등기명령 before moving out).

cfpb-002.quote:
No person shall give and no person shall accept any fee, kickback, or thing of value pursuant to any agreement or understanding, oral or 
otherwise, that business incident to or a part of 
a real estate settlement service involving a federally related mortgage loan shall be referred to 
any person.

cfpb-003.quote:
No person shall give and no person shall accept any portion, split, or percentage of any 
charge made or received for the rendering of a 
real estate settlement service in connection 
with a transaction involving a federally related 
mortgage loan other than for services actually 
performed.

elr-021.quote: 임대차가 끝난 후 보증금이 반환되지 아니한 경우 임차인은 임차주택의 소재지를 관할하는 지방법원ㆍ지방법원지원 또는 시ㆍ군 법원에 임차권등기명령을 신청할 수 있다.
